concerns.text: The plan states that the entire pipeline is wrapped in a single notebook `analysis.ipynb` located at the repository root, but the Quickstart guide refers to `notebooks/analysis.ipynb`. This path mismatch will cause the Quickstart command `papermill notebooks/analysis.ipynb …` to fail unless the notebook is moved or the guide is updated.

Phase 0 lists FR‑001 (download BTC & ETH from verified URLs). In the feature specification (spec.md) FR‑001 requires downloading daily OHLCV data from the CoinGecko public API. The plan’s use of Hugging Face URLs therefore conflicts with the functional requirement defined in the spec, creating an inconsistency between design artifacts.
